limitations: A 512-pixel-wide phone screen recording resolves small cartoon heads but cannot prove detailed facial resemblance.
A portrait visible under staff Head Coach free agents is known to be staff-pool compatible; applying it to an employed coach still needs new import check.
The 2020 celebrity photos were used only for real-world general appearance; their image files are not included or copied into the game.
All 96 OC/DC/ST coaching chairs remain unchanged pending image review; scouts/doctors and free agents are untouched.
Duplicate staff portrait IDs may be reused if closest; do not require unique portraits at expense of resemblance.
